item.title: How to generate UUID in JavaScript
item.description: Generating unique identifiers is essential for JavaScript applications that need to create unique keys, track items, or assign temporary IDs. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented UUID generation in countless production systems. The most reliable solution is to use the native crypto.randomUUID() method available in modern browsers and Node.js. This approach generates cryptographically strong UUIDs without external dependencies.
